cells.announcement: July 29, 2025: End-of-Life (EoL) announcement  – Customers on KSS NG 1.2.1 should begin transitioning to the latest version of KSS NG.
cells.eoe: September 29, 2025: End-of-Engineering (EoE)  – Service releases, bug fixes, workarounds, and service packs for KSS NG 1.2.1 will no longer be supported by SolarWinds.
cells.eol: September 29, 2026: End-of-Life  – SolarWinds will no longer provide technical support for KSS NG 1.2.1.
